title: Aubrey Marcus had a DMT experience during a darkness retreat

tellings.quote: >> this wasn't like DMT. This was a DMT. I had a DMT experience whilst you know after the fourth or fifth day in in this darkness retreat.

plain: A neuroscientist, Andrew Gallimore, tells podcast host Jesse Michels what a man named Aubrey Marcus told him about a darkness retreat, where a person spends days in total darkness. According to Gallimore, Marcus said that after the fourth or fifth day he had an experience that was not just like DMT, a powerful psychedelic substance, but was a full DMT experience. If true, it would suggest that darkness alone can open the same strange inner world the drug does.
